story.fullStory:
Judas Priest's "You'Ve Got Another Thing Comin'" reached #67 on the Billboard Hot 100. "You've Got Another Thing Comin'" is a song by English heavy metal band Judas Priest.

It was originally released on their 1982 album Screaming for Vengeance and released as a single later that year.

In May 2006, VH1 ranked it fifth on their list of the 40 Greatest Metal Songs.

The song peaked at #67 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 7 weeks on the chart.
